area: 18th Street at a restaurant, metro Bakersfield
disposition: Both parties on scene; under investigation
summary: Officers were sent to a just-occurred domestic violence call at a restaurant on 18th Street. Both parties were on scene when officers arrived.
A 13-year-old girl was reported missing from the fairgrounds carnival, last seen near the Bud Pavilion stage.

area: Clear Creek Road, Kern River Valley
summary: A caller on Clear Creek Road reported someone burning trash in a yard. Deputies went to check.
A 2-year-old girl was reported missing from the carousel area of the fairgrounds carnival.
A report of shots fired in the carnival's amusement area drew a large response. Officers found a large disturbance and no evidence of gunfire. Several subjects ran from the area and were not located.

area: Highway 170 just east of the canyon mouth
summary: Fire crews were sent to a vehicle reported on the side of Highway 170 just east of the mouth of the canyon, with unknown injuries.
An 11-year-old boy was reported missing from the main carnival area near the Ferris wheel.

area: Buena Vista Road at a pharmacy
summary: Officers were asked to check on someone at a pharmacy on Buena Vista Road.
Officers were sent to a fight in the north corner of the fairgrounds carnival.
Officers responded to a disturbance at an apartment on Kentucky Street involving a woman in her 20s.
Officers were sent to check on a woman reported to be held against her will at a Bakersfield home.
Deputies were sent to a suspicious person report on Wible Road involving a juvenile riding a bike with another juvenile.
A fire started on the right-hand shoulder of Highway 155 near Old State Road. Crews also searched the frontage road and Highway 99 between Garces and Cecil for a suspect.
Officers handled a collision with minor injuries at Ming Avenue and Allen Road.

area: Union Avenue at a grocery store, metro Bakersfield
summary: Officers went code 33 to a grocery store on Union Avenue for a suspicious person.
Crews were sent to Oak Street for a first-time seizure.
Fire crews were dispatched to a three-vehicle collision on southbound Highway 99 at 7th Standard Road.
Officers were asked to check on a report of a woman wedged between a fence and a parking lot about 200 yards south of a fast-food restaurant in south Bakersfield.
Officers were sent to a priority assault call on Monterey Street involving a man and a woman who had been fighting.
A possible impaired driver was reported in the area of Monterey Street and Union Avenue.
Crews were sent to a report of a person about 70 years old who was not breathing and not moving.

disposition: Large group on scene; units responding
summary: Officers responded to a possible domestic disturbance involving a woman in a black SUV. A large group of people had shown up to the location.

disposition: Crews staged; scene cleared to enter
summary: Medical crews were sent to California City Boulevard and cleared to enter the scene for a shooting.
A collision on South 8th Street sent officers looking for a silver Honda that left the scene. The car was last seen heading west on Highway 58 from Allen Road.
A caller reported two people riding a white ATV near Crest Drive.

disposition: Occupants out of the vehicle; balance cancelled
summary: A single vehicle hit a tree on Taylor Street. Occupants were out of the vehicle and one engine company handled the call.

area: Southbound Highway 99 north of Kimberlina Road
disposition: One occupant out of the vehicle
summary: A single vehicle off the roadway on southbound Highway 99 north of Kimberlina Road was fully engulfed in flames. The one occupant was out and conscious.
Officers were sent to a domestic violence call on College Avenue. A juvenile caller reported his parents were fighting and that his father was bleeding and had left the home.
Officers were sent to a loud-music disturbance on East Brundage Lane with a report of possible shots heard in the area.
Crews were sent to a gas leak reported in a neighborhood on Palm Avenue.

A just-occurred assault on Edwards Avenue left a victim breathing but unconscious. A second person, a teen girl in a red jacket and blue jeans, was seen running from the scene. The victim was conscious and talking with officers later in the call.
Officers were sent to a man down in his 30s lying next to a bicycle at the driveway entrance of a restaurant on California Avenue.
Crews were sent to a medical aid on Fairwood Street.

disposition: CPR in progress; crews on scene
summary: Crews responded to a person not breathing on Curtis Drive with CPR in progress.
Crews were sent to a heart problem call on Kirkcaldy Drive; the patient was not alert.
An engine company was sent to a commercial fire alarm at a senior living complex on Mount Vernon Avenue.

Fire and medical crews were sent to a vehicle rollover with a possible ejection at Edison Highway and Tower Line. Crews confirmed there was no ejection and two patients were out of the vehicle, conscious and breathing.
Crews were sent to an ill patient on Vancouver Drive.
Person with traumatic injury near Stephen Court.
Person found unresponsive at Sherwood Lake Ct in Bakersfield.
Hospital request for gunshot wound victim.
